[[Category:Recipes using potato]]

These chips are just as good as store-bought.

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] Russet [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], sliced thinly on a [[Cookbook:Mandoline|mandoline]]
* [[Cookbook:Barbecue Rub|Barbecue Rub]]
* [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]] for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep frying]]

== Procedure ==
#Heat oil to 375°F. 
#Add potatoes to hot oil one slice at a time, working in batches as needed. Fry potatoes for 4–5 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
#Once all potatoes have been fried, sprinkle liberally with the barbecue rub.
#Serve.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Don't fry too many potato slices at once—doing so will cause the oil temperature to drop.
